tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain that is not working: whether the name resolves in public DNS, then the eleven-check audit of its zone, each row ok, warn, fail or skipped with why. DNS only, not HTTP or TLS. Measured from the isitdns edge and its probes, never the caller's network. from moves the recursion, TTL and U

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Dig one name and type at one resolver on the board (the resolvers isitdns monitors), or at Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard side by side (resolver all): records, flags, rcode, EDE, latency. Asked over DoH from the isitdns edge. from moves the question to that region's probe as Do53 over UDP, an

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Trace a delegation from the root to the authority: each referral and its glue, the one server that answered at each zone cut and any dial that failed, the final answer and its TTLs. Each hop is asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, named on the hop. Give the full host name: the

tools.name: dnssec_chain
tools.description: Walk the DNSSEC chain from the root to one answer for a validation failure or key change: DS and DNSKEY at each signed zone cut, key tags, signers, signature windows, the first link that breaks or goes insecure, and whether that insecure zone is itself signed (an island of security). Read through Cl

tools.name: sweep_domain
tools.description: Sweep a zone's nameservers: the same names and types asked at a sample of its authoritative addresses, reporting disagreements, lame or silent servers, serial and TTL differences, the CAA in effect, and each _acme-challenge TXT or CNAME. Asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, nam

tools.name: registration
tools.description: Read whether a domain is expired or on hold from its registry's RDAP server: each status with what it means for resolution, the registration, expiry and change dates, the nameservers, whether the delegation is signed. Read over HTTPS from the isitdns edge through IANA's RDAP bootstrap, and no contac
